pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Start **LAYOUT-002**, a separate ALLEGRO-style LAr alternative to the Si–W LAYOUT-001. Keep the tracker and proposed inner 3 T solenoid, retain the published inclined Pb/steel/PCB sampling dimensions, and enlarge the cryostat and HCAL/service reservations to accommodate cold electronics and cooling.

This first PR implements the barrel and common service budget. Dependent [PR #74](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/74) completes the turbine geometry, marks the forward FCal insertion and adds LAYOUT-002 to the README-linked layout main page.

## Changes

- Real 1536 inclined periods, 11 compartments and two active LAr gaps; 33,792 raw sensitive volumes and 2,285,568 merged channels, with a signed theta field and canonical references.
- Explicit warm/vacuum/cold walls, 170 mm rear bath, 16 H-rings, 5,888 cold-board slots and 96 nitrogen half-branches, with conserved bath displacement.
- HCAL front apothem 3.13 m, unchanged 1.4959 m sampling/cover depth, 0.8 m front and 0.5 m rear endcap service gaps. Cable counts, fill, bend, bandwidth and power assumptions are reproducible and identified as planning choices.
- Isolated DD4hep factory and validation tools; no production integration or imported FCC/key4hep package.

## Validation and limits

Native complete barrel: zero overlaps at 10 nm, native shape/material/exclusive-mass/readout checks and 45 fixed material rays. One sparse Geant4 event has a saved positive-energy canonical LAr hit. All 13 standard-library geometry/service/saved-hit controls pass; project and session records validate.

Independent SysArch and PhysVal assessments reviewed the implementation; accounting, source-convention and ghost-cell findings are corrected. Retained execution source: 5f8c505e26f0f325f17d801583042849f06f62a2. Project validation and token-site CI passed at 48e97256f8badd75c022a84ab1c4ff71977c56a2. Cryostat ports, connectors, headers, structural/thermal/hydraulic qualification, showers/digitization, ACTS conversion and enlarged-HCAL magnetic response remain open. DES032 is DRAFT / PROTOTYPE; no engineering sign-off is implied.

Generic child contexts received explicit role instructions; native profile
loading is not claimed. Contract preparation precedes dispatch below.

- `ECAL-REVIEW-PubDoc-draft`, child `/root/layout_main_page`: authored only
  `brief.json` against source commit a53c29867130b4c36658a9aa5f6f14dd5650130f.
  Returned a concise four-page common source, public links and unsigned-state
  wording; schema/table/link/word-count checks passed. Its earlier SoftEng role
  was explicitly replaced by PubDoc. It is the author, not an independent reviewer.
- `ECAL-REVIEW-PhysVal-budget`, child `/root/lar_fit_physval`: read-only exact
  source review. Checked all nine initial hash bindings, primary mass/material
  sums, HCAL corner/envelope derivations, service/heat and coverage limitations.
  Returned corrected LAr both-end mass 131.173 t (the old 139.557 t value is
  superseded), tracker+Be inventory 2.860 t, and missing installed/HCAL budgets.
  An initial statement about a top-level Air inventory entry was withdrawn after
  exact primary-source inspection; no Air claim is retained. This child helped
  earlier LAr design work; that origin overlap is disclosed. No native jobs,
  edits, dependency installs or human sign-off were performed by this assignment.

Coordinator reconciled the facts, included the pinned solenoid material note as
source 10, and changed the endcap support shorthand to wheel support tubes.
